# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech Job for Entrepreneurship](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a stable tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and build something meaningful.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): Opinionated orchestrator for Claude Code that streamlines autonomous software development with integrated agents and workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color theory principles including wheels, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container's Impact](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized containers revolutionized global trade, displaced dock workers, and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed guide to sourdough fermentation, microbial symbiosis, acid development, and baking chemistry.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial cycles.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits similar to human speech development.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and Web Mercator's dominance.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage strategies, and biological applications of glowing organisms.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How a Tokyo boy's insect collecting inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of development.
- [Pokémon Competitive Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built Pokémon's competitive ruleset through datamining and community innovation.
- [Pokémon Red Blue Generation One Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous bugs in Pokémon Red and Blue including MissingNo., the truck myth, and the Mew glitch.
